channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Crise entre Milei e Lula ofusca apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro nas redes, diz pesquisa
item.description: Javier Milei's support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy lost traction in online discourse amid the escalating diplomatic crisis between the Argentine president and Lula. Datrix Digital's analysis of 3,990 social media posts from July 18 to August 11, 2026, found that the bilateral conflict overshadowed mentions of Milei's backing for the Bolsonaro-aligned candidate.

item.title: 2027, a hora da verdade
item.description: 2027 will be a moment of truth for Brazil, regardless of who wins the presidential election, due to the country's structural fiscal knot. Economists warn that the next president will have to confront high debt, primary deficits, and pressure for fiscal adjustment. The situation demands tough choices on spending, taxation, and structural reforms.

item.title: Missão aciona TSE e entrega dados para identificar autor de filiação fraudulenta de Flávio
item.description: The Mission Party filed a request with the TSE to investigate the fraudulent party affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming to have technical evidence identifying who carried out the unauthorized registration. The party asserts that false data was entered into the system and seeks accountability for the act.

item.title: Edmilson Costa registra candidatura à Presidência e declara patrimônio de R$ 454 mil ao TSE
item.description: Edmilson Costa, the PCB candidate for President of Brazil, registered his candidacy with the TSE on Friday, the 14th, declaring assets worth R$ 454,400. Four years ago, in 2022, he had declared assets of R$ 502,000, showing a decrease of R$ 47,600 in his reported wealth.

item.title: Lula adia aprovação de embaixador dos EUA para depois das eleições
item.description: President Lula (PT) stated he will only grant agrément to U.S. Ambassador-designate Daniel Perez after the October elections, delaying the appointment until after the vote. Lula criticized the Trump administration's delay in nominating the diplomat, suggesting the U.S. intended to send two representatives to Brazil.

item.title: Crusoé: Por que Gakiya recusou o convite de Caiado
item.description: Lincoln Gakiya, a prosecutor from the Gaeco unit of São Paulo’s Public Ministry, declined an invitation from presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) to lead the Ministry of Public Security. He expressed gratitude and said he felt honored, but chose not to accept the position. The refusal came before any formal negotiations took place.

item.title: Lula diz que só acatará indicação de embaixador dos EUA após eleições
item.description: Lula said Brazil will only grant agrément to the U.S. nominee for ambassador, Daniel Perez, after the October elections, criticizing the delay and timing of the U.S. appointment. He emphasized that Brazil does not seek conflict with the U.S. but is prepared to defend its interests, having invoked the Law of Reciprocity in response to U.S. tariffs and false accusations.

item.title: Lula quer conversa com Trump: “vou dizer, não se meta no Brasil”
item.description: President Lula said he wants a direct conversation with Trump to address bilateral relations and, especially, to prevent U.S. interference in Brazil's 2026 elections. He criticized the delay in nominating U.S. Ambassador Daniel Perez and refused to rush the agrément process near the election, stating he does not want war but serious dialogue and to prevail through narrative.

item.title: O que o Brasil ganha e o que arrisca ao acionar lei para revidar 'tarifaço' dos EUA?
item.description: Brazil has initiated the process to apply its Economic Reciprocity Law in response to U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, aiming to assert its position in trade negotiations and counter what the government calls a 'false narrative' behind the American measures. While the move could strengthen Brazil’s stance in negotiations, experts warn it may trigger an escalation of trade tensions, posing risks to the national economy, particularly if measures are implemented ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump é “o melhor” do alto escalão dos EUA hoje
item.description: Lula stated that Donald Trump is 'the best' among the top officials in the U.S. government and the one who speaks most seriously with him, emphasizing his effort to maintain a respectful relationship despite differences. He urged the U.S. not to interfere in Brazilian elections and criticized Secretary of State Marco Rubio for disliking Brazil and Latin America, while affirming he does not seek conflict with the United States.

item.title: Qual é a história do filme Que Horas Ela Volta? citado por Lula em entrevista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva cited the film Que Horas Ela Volta? (2015), directed by Anna Muylaert and starring Regina Casé, during an interview to criticize class prejudice among Brazil’s elite. He noted how the film portrays resistance from wealthier sectors to the social ascent of poor workers, drawing parallels to his own experience facing backlash when low-income individuals began using airports and other spaces previously associated with the upper class.

item.title: Lula diz que só ele e Bolsonaro são líderes nacionais e cobra que aliados se projetem
item.description: Lula stated that only he and Bolsonaro are national leaders and urged his allies to travel across the country to project themselves beyond their home states. He emphasized the need to expand the PT and its allies' presence nationally to strengthen their political project ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Múcio aprova diretriz que autoriza uso das Forças Armadas nas eleições
item.description: Defense Minister José Múcio approved a directive authorizing the use of the Armed Forces in the 2026 elections to ensure security, public order, and logistical support, including transport of electronic ballots and personnel to remote areas. The measure follows a decree by President Lula issued in July and aims to align military action with decisions from the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Vasco nas eleições 2026: Edmundo, Pantera, MC Darlan e mãe do menino Gui levam o cruzmaltino às urnas
item.description: Former Vasco da Gama players, including Edmundo, Donizete Pantera, MC Darlan, and Tayane Mãe do Gui, are running for political office in the 2026 elections. Edmundo is seeking a state deputy position under the PSDB, while Pantera is running for the same role under the PL. MC Darlan, creator of the Vasco anthem song, is running for federal deputy from Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Alcolumbre destrava PEC do fim da 6x1 após conversas com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre forwarded the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule to the Constitution and Justice Committee after institutional talks with President Lula. He also referred the Public Security PEC and the Critical Minerals Bill to relevant committees, all executive priorities. The move followed pressure from MDB and PT, who demand plenary voting on the measures.

item.title: Patrimônio de Flávio Bolsonaro cresce 370% desde eleição de 2018
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) net worth increased by 370% since his 2018 Senate election, rising from R$1.74 million to R$8.1 million, according to his asset declaration filed with the TSE for the 2026 presidential race. The substantial growth raises concerns about the origins of the wealth and financial transparency of politicians during campaigns.

item.title: Crusoé: Rueda declara patrimônio de R$ 75 milhões à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Antonio de Rueda, national president of União Brasil and pre-candidate for federal deputy from Rio de Janeiro, declared a wealth of R$ 75.65 million to the Electoral Justice for the 2026 elections. The amount includes R$ 14.65 million in financial investments and R$ 9 million in corporate participation, plus real estate such as an apartment in São Paulo.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: líderes do Senado veem chance de votação entre 1º e 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Senate leaders suggest the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule could be voted between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, following coordination between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula. The proposal is a government priority but faces opposition resistance and lacks a designated rapporteur, with a dispute between government allies and Senator Efraim Filho (PL-PB).

item.title: Estela Aranha será relatora do registro de Flávio à Presidência no TSE
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE will serve as rapporteur for the candidacy registration request of Flávio Bolsonaro for President of the Republic, after the case was assigned to her by prevention. She is already rapporteur of the PL’s main presidential election process, which includes the ticket of Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar. The request was filed on the evening of August 13, and Flávio declared R$ 8.1 million in assets — nearly double Lula’s declaration but far below Romeu Zema’s.

item.title: Ciro Gomes acha que o mundo gira em torno dele, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula said that Ciro Gomes believes the world revolves around him, criticizing his personalistic attitude and lack of humility. He noted that Ciro has switched parties multiple times and fails to fit into collective efforts, despite acknowledging his past positive qualities.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: Os quatro estados com disputas mais difíceis e equilibradas do Brasil até agora
item.description: Four states — Bahia, Rio Grande do Sul, Pernambuco, and Pará — are experiencing extremely tight electoral races in 2026, with technical ties within the margin of error between leading candidates. In each case, the lack of a clear advantage suggests results could be decided vote by vote, requiring close attention from analysts and parties.

item.title: Lula defende fim das apostas online e diz saber de 'bancada das bets'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that, if it were up to him, online betting (bets) would be abolished in Brazil unless proven to have a relevant social function. He said he sees no reason to maintain betting houses if they do not demonstrate social benefit.

item.title: Renan Santos denuncia à PF ameaça de morte por suposto aluno da USP
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, had his campaign team report a death threat to the Federal Police, allegedly made by a man identifying himself as a USP student online. The complaint was filed on August 14, 2026, at 2:12 PM. The campaign states the threat is serious and requests an immediate investigation.

item.title: Mendonça promete conduzir casos Master e INSS com imparcialidade e quer evitar erros da Lava Jato
item.description: Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça stated he will oversee the Banco Master and INSS investigations with impartiality, technical rigor, and respect for due process, aiming to avoid mistakes similar to those in Operation Car Wash. He emphasized the importance of public trust in judicial institutions and stressed that corruption has no partisan color, requiring decisions based on evidence, not political or ideological motivations.

item.title: Lula brinca sobre promessa do Ministério do Namoro: "Próximo governo"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva joked about his 2022 campaign promise to create a Ministry of Dating, saying he will establish it in the next government. He said he wants to be the minister and that First Lady Janja would be his secretary, responding to public pressure and podcast hosts.

item.title: Lula diz que derrota eleitoral no Ceará é ‘humanamente impossível’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that an electoral defeat in Ceará for the pro-government slate led by Governor Elmano de Freitas is 'humanly impossible', citing support from Camilo Santana and Cid Gomes. He said he will travel to the state to strengthen the campaign and link voters' support for him to Elmano, and promised to revive the Science Without Borders program in a potential fourth term, focusing on AI, mathematics, and engineering.

item.title: Senado pede entendimento de Lula com EUA antes de escalada comercial
item.description: Senator Nelsinho Trad urged the Lula government to seek dialogue with the U.S. before imposing retaliatory tariffs, supporting the use of Brazil's Economic Reciprocity Law while advocating for negotiation as a first step. Brazil has initiated the reciprocity process against U.S. tariffs of 25% and 12.5%, which could reach 37.5% on Brazilian goods, in response to a Section 301 investigation by the USTR alleging unfair trade practices.

item.title: Crusoé: O peso da corrupção
item.description: Voting intention polls for Brazil's 2026 elections reveal that, despite 36% of Brazilians identifying corruption as the country's top problem according to an Ipsos July survey, the electorate shows significant tolerance toward candidates under investigation or linked to corruption schemes. The article 'Crusoé: O peso da corrupção,' published by O Antagonista, highlights this contradiction between public concern and actual voting behavior.

item.title: Lula sobre investigação contra Lulinha: "Ninguém vai pedir fechamento"
item.description: President Lula defended the ongoing investigations into his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), stating he instructed his legal team not to seek the dismissal of any inquiry. He said he believes in his son's innocence but emphasized that 'only he knows the truth' and that there will be no attempt to block investigations into alleged corruption and influence-peddling related to medicinal cannabis business in the Ministry of Health.

item.title: Os argumentos pró e contra o vídeo de Jair Bolsonaro feito por IA
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is reviewing a PT complaint against an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL national convention, in which the avatar urged support for Flávio Bolsonaro. The PT claims the video circumvented Bolsonaro’s ban on public speech and violated electoral rules by indirectly soliciting votes. The PL defense argues the event was private, avatars are standard in campaigns, and compares the video to Lula masks used by Haddad in 2018, asserting that AI use is allowed if clearly labeled as such.

item.title: Patrimônio de Flávio Bolsonaro tem carro de R$ 427 mil registrado em nome de escritório de advocacia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared a patrimony of R$ 8.18 million to the TSE, nearly five times higher than in 2018, highlighted by a 2025 Mercedes-Benz GLC 300 4Matic valued at R$ 427,500, registered under his law firm. Electoral law allows assets of legal entities not to be individually declared by partners, which the senator justified as regular and properly accounted. The property where he lives, valued at R$ 6.2 million, also serves as the law firm’s headquarters.

item.title: Lula diz que Haddad tem ‘potencial de crescimento’, mas precisa de ‘um pouco mais para ser líder’
item.description: President Lula praised Fernando Haddad's growth potential but said he needs more leadership qualities to lead the left. He also mentioned Camilo Santana, Rui Costa, Guilherme Boulos, João Campos, and Rafael Fonteles as future leaders, criticizing Brazil's lack of national parties and national-level leadership, stating that only he and Bolsonaro have embodied such a profile in recent history.

item.title: Lula diz que vai recriar Ciência sem Fronteiras com foco em IA
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) announced that, if re-elected in 2026, he will relaunch the Science without Borders program with a focus on Artificial Intelligence, mathematics, and engineering. The program, originally launched in 2011 and terminated in 2017, funded scholarships for Brazilian students and researchers to study abroad. Lula emphasized that investment in education is crucial for national development and sovereignty.

item.title: Deepfake decide eleição? O que revelam 6 exemplos de outros países
item.description: The article examines the rising threat of deepfakes in elections, citing six international examples where manipulated content influenced democratic processes. While the focus is global, it warns of Brazil’s vulnerability to increasingly accessible and realistic AI tools, particularly in a context already marked by polarization and established disinformation.

item.title: Lula diz acreditar que Lulinha é inocente, mas que inquéritos não serão interrompidos
item.description: President Lula said he believes his son, Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha), is innocent of influence trafficking allegations, but stressed that investigations will not be dropped. He urged his son to fight if innocent or hire a lawyer if guilty, referencing his own 580-day imprisonment during Operation Car Wash, and noted that his son witnessed the family's suffering during that period.

item.title: Missão aciona TSE para investigar filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Mission Party filed a criminal complaint with the TSE, alleging fraudulent affiliation of Flávio Bolsonaro to the party and requesting an investigation based on technical data that, according to the party, could identify the perpetrator of the alleged fraud. The case was assigned to Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques. The action aims to investigate potential electoral irregularities involving the senator.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: dívida, impostos e privatizações expõem dois planos opostos para a economia
item.description: Lula proposes maintaining the current fiscal framework, relying on economic growth and efficiency to improve public accounts without explicit spending cuts, though his economic team has suggested tightening the rule in investor meetings. Flávio Bolsonaro advocates replacing the framework with a new rule centered on reducing public debt relative to GDP, including primary surpluses, cutting ministries and administrative spending, and aggressively restarting privatizations. Both plans lack detail, but diverge in direction: Lula seeks to preserve and adjust the existing regime; Flávio aims to replace it with debt as the explicit anchor.

item.title: “Quero que faça como eu fiz”, diz Lula ao defender inocência de Lulinha em investigação
item.description: President Lula stated he trusts in the innocence of his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), in the INSS investigation and affirmed he will not interfere in the process, urging his son to face legal proceedings as he did during Operation Car Wash. Lula said he wants Lulinha to 'do as I did', referencing his own imprisonment and subsequent vindication, and called for judicial speed. Lulinha is the subject of three investigations at the STF.

item.title: Filiação fake de Flávio vira campanha grátis para Renan
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was the target of a fraudulent affiliation with the Mission party, led by Renan Santos, which inadvertently generated free publicity advantageous to the politician. Although based on falsehood, the incident was exploited as a free campaign opportunity for Renan, who gained visibility at no cost. The situation reflects the absurd and often fictional tone of the current Brazilian political landscape.

item.title: Lula diz que só dará agrément a embaixador após eleições e que tenta conversa com Trump
item.description: Lula stated that he will only grant agrément to an ambassador after the 2026 elections and that he is attempting to initiate dialogue with Donald Trump. He also positioned himself as a re-election candidate, reinforcing his strategy to avoid diplomatic appointments before the vote.

item.title: Após reatar com Lula, Alcolumbre encaminha PEC do fim da 6x1 no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) stated that he has forwarded the government Lula's priority projects to committees, including the Public Security PEC and the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale. This move signals alignment between the Legislative and Executive branches on security and labor reform agendas.

item.title: MP Eleitoral cobra governo Tarcísio e pede câmeras sobre abordagem a Haddad
item.description: The Electoral Public Prosecutor's Office (MPE) has given the government of Tarcísio de Freitas five days to explain the Military Police's approach to the driver of Fernando Haddad, the Workers' Party candidate for governor of São Paulo, which is alleged to constitute an abuse of authority and political intimidation. The investigation aims to determine whether public force was improperly used against Haddad's campaign, potentially constituting an electoral crime.

item.title: Lula cita reciprocidade aos EUA e diz que Brasil "não é pouca coisa”
item.description: President Lula accused the United States of spreading 'falsehoods' against Brazil and announced the invocation of the Reciprocity Law to show that Brazil 'is not insignificant'. He stated that Brazil was hit with a 12.5% additional tariff based on the false claim of using slave labor, arguing the measure is actually an attack on China. Lula also said he is seeking a direct conversation with Donald Trump to ask him not to interfere in Brazilian elections, despite maintaining a good personal relationship with the former U.S. president.

item.title: Lula diz não saber a verdade sobre caso Lulinha, mas que acredita no filho e quer investigação
item.description: President Lula stated he believes in his son's innocence amid three investigations and instructed his lawyers not to seek case closures, emphasizing the need for thorough inquiries. However, he admitted he does not know the truth about what occurred. The remarks were made on Friday, August 14, 2026.

item.title: A estratégia de Lula para ‘vencer’ tarifas dos Estados Unidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated he aims to 'defeat' the United States through 'narrative', arguing that recent tariffs on Brazil — 25% for alleged unfair trade practices and up to 12.5% for failures in combating slave labor — were based on lies. He emphasized that while he lacks U.S.-level military or nuclear power, he will rely on truth and the conscience of the Brazilian people to counter the accusations, claiming the tariffs are a disguised attack on China and overlook Brazil’s efforts against deforestation.

item.title: Lula diz que Lulinha vai ser punido se for culpado: 'Só ele sabe a verdade, eu não sei'
item.description: Lula stated that his eldest son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), will be held accountable if guilt is proven in ongoing investigations, though he expressed trust in his son's innocence. He said he instructed Lulinha's lawyers not to seek dismissal of the cases and wants the investigations to proceed normally, as they did against him. Lula avoided commenting on the actions of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, who oversees some of the probes, citing tensions between branches of government and the risk of making value judgments.

item.title: Davi divulga nota sobre a pauta do Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre released a press note regarding the referral of three priority proposals to Senate committees: ending the 6x1 work schedule, the Public Security PEC, and the creation of the National Policy on Critical and Strategic Minerals. He emphasized that these matters will follow the Senate's regular procedural rules, with due analysis by relevant committees, following an institutional dialogue with President Lula.

item.title: Bispo diz que desgaste com caso Dark Horse decantou, e Flávio Bolsonaro se reaproxima de evangélicos
item.description: Bishop Robson Rodovalho states that the fallout from the revelation that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro asked for money from Daniel Vorcaro, then owner of Banco Master, has 'settled' and no longer causes significant damage among evangelical voters. He claims the senator is reapproaching this religious segment. The controversy, which emerged in 2024, appears to be losing electoral impact in 2026.

item.title: Alcolumbre manda avançar fim da 6x1, PEC da Segurança e minerais críticos após reuniões com Lula
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced the advancement of three priority proposals to relevant committees: PEC 221/2019 ending the 6x1 work schedule, PEC 18/2025 on public security, and PL 2780/2024 establishing a National Policy on Critical and Strategic Minerals. The move followed meetings with President Lula, whom Alcolumbre said had restored dialogue after tensions stemming from the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' STF nomination.

item.title: Após reatar com Lula, Alcolumbre destravará PECs do fim da escala 6×1 e da segurança pública
item.description: After multiple meetings with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will unblock the processing of two PECs: one to end the 6×1 work scale and another to strengthen public security, both priorities of the executive in Congress. The proposals, which had been stalled due to a rift between Lula and Alcolumbre, will now proceed to the CCJ for review before a plenary vote. Despite the reconciliation, advancement is expected only after the 2026 elections due to a congested legislative schedule.
